ranked.headline: Stability and subgroup-aware statistical inference across omics data modalities
ranked.summary: Recent omics methods increasingly test whether inferred structure persists across resampling, resolution, and patient strata rather than a single dataset.

ranked.headline: Learned embeddings and graph models reshape single-cell cell type annotation
ranked.summary: Foundation models, graph networks and interpretable neural networks now target cell typing under donor, subtype and domain shift.

ranked.headline: Omics inference models encode sample, spatial, and perturbation context explicitly
ranked.summary: Foundation models, causal transformers and federated methods now target sample, spatial and perturbation structure in single-cell and spatial omics.

ranked.headline: Matched-platform benchmarks and probe audits test spatial transcriptomics fidelity
ranked.summary: Recent matched-tissue platform comparisons and Xenium specificity audits make cross-platform measurement fidelity directly testable.

ranked.headline: Contrastive and optimal transport models align single-cell and spatial omics modalities
ranked.summary: Recent 2026 reports pair learned alignment with interpretable, biology-constrained representations across single-cell, spatial and histology data.

ranked.headline: Learned models are predicting TCR, HLA and B-cell epitope immune recognition
ranked.summary: Benchmarks on unseen TCR-pMHC complexes and curated real negatives are testing whether learned immune-recognition models generalize.

ranked.headline: Deep learning models are extending genomic variant and sequence-function prediction
ranked.summary: Recent papers apply DNA language models, U-Nets and VAEs to mutation rates, splice variants and metagenomic binning, with benchmarks testing cross-species…

ranked.headline: Graph neural networks model drug action, protein interactions, and metabolic gaps
ranked.summary: Graph learning is now applied to knowledge graphs, residue-level structures, and reaction networks for target, drug, and metabolism prediction.

ranked.headline: Protein language model embeddings gain structural and multimodal context across tasks
ranked.summary: Papers dated April to May 2026 pair protein language model embeddings with structural, dynamical, and chemical features.

ranked.headline: Protein language model embeddings adapted for function, structure, and dynamics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications pair pLM embeddings with contrastive, diffusion, and graph models to address low-homology and data-limited prediction.

ranked.headline: Structure-informed models widen protein sequence design and analysis
ranked.summary: Predicted structures and 3D context are increasingly used to guide sequence design, substitution modeling, and variant analysis from sequence inputs.

ranked.headline: Learned models of molecules and proteins face scrutiny under distribution shift
ranked.summary: Benchmarks and error-control methods now test whether biological ML models hold up when test data depart from training distributions.

ranked.headline: New methods embed and reconstruct single-cell transcriptomic and chromatin structure
ranked.summary: Recent work introduces or benchmarks embedding, clustering, and 3D reconstruction methods aimed at preserving structure beyond UMAP and t-SNE.

ranked.headline: Methylation profiling extended to low-input, spatial, and repetitive DNA contexts
ranked.summary: Platform benchmarks and new tools test methylation measurement fidelity as profiling moves into low-input, FFPE, spatial, and repeat-resolved sample types.

ranked.headline: Long-read RNA variant calling and isoform reconstruction methods are benchmarked
ranked.summary: Recent benchmarks evaluate long-read RNA variant callers against community reference resources, alongside new isoform and typing tools.

ranked.headline: Standardized benchmarks and DIA ion-level recovery target proteomics software validity
ranked.summary: Recent work pairs standardized, leakage-aware benchmarks with DIA tools that recover missing ion-level values before quantification.

ranked.headline: Quantitative MRI reconstructs brain fluid transport, iron and myelin mapping, and…
ranked.summary: Recent work extends MRI reconstruction to subject-specific transport fields, longitudinal susceptibility maps, and cross-species connectivity atlases.

ranked.headline: Richer input representations sharpen pathogen resistance and antigenic site prediction
ranked.summary: Protein language model embeddings and SHAP-attributed models now yield interpretable predictions across HIV, influenza, and TB datasets.

ranked.headline: Inherited variants are resolved into tissue-specific regulatory and splicing effects
ranked.summary: Joint multi-tissue frameworks now link inherited variants to splicing, mtRNA processing, TF binding, and disease risk in population cohorts.

ranked.headline: Structural context packaged into pipelines for PTM, variant, and RNA-model analysis
ranked.summary: Residue-level structural mapping is being delivered as scalable, open-source tools with faster search and variant-level outputs.

ranked.headline: Joint sequence-structure generation for protein design via learned representations
ranked.summary: May 2026 preprints extend protein language models and atomistic diffusion to de novo functional, multidomain, and binder design.

ranked.headline: Genetic and omic inputs driving predictive models for disease and biomarker discovery
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and 2026 benchmarks test whether added model complexity and multi-omic fusion improve genetic and omic prediction.

ranked.headline: Refined co-expression networks extract gene modules from public transcriptome data
ranked.summary: Recent work pairs new network and regulon methods with diagnostics for probe artifacts and cross-platform harmonization affecting gene-level inference.

ranked.headline: Viewer-grounded agents and closed-loop tools for interactive spatial omics analysis
ranked.summary: Three early-May 2026 preprints propose interactive, viewer-coupled agentic systems for spatial omics analysis.

ranked.headline: Site-resolution computational inference of RNA processing and regulatory features
ranked.summary: Benchmarks and new site-level methods now test how well computational tools resolve polyadenylation and splicing in APA-seq and scRNA-seq.

ranked.headline: Explicit dynamical models map amyloid, neural, and sleep-onset dynamics over time
ranked.summary: Joint calibration across cohorts and single-recording estimation now let dynamical models constrain individual brain trajectories and interactions.

ranked.headline: Deep models fuse chromatin, sequence and reporter data to predict regulatory links
ranked.summary: Chromatin accessibility, reporter assays and 3D contacts are increasingly fused with sequence in deep models of enhancer-gene links and TF binding.

ranked.headline: Open software standardizes microbial genome assembly, metadata, and strain-level analysis
ranked.summary: A 60,126-run harmonized catalog of public MENA metagenomes highlights the need for standardized, reproducible microbial genomics tooling.

ranked.headline: Learned models design and score nanobodies, aptamers, RNA, and Cas9 variants
ranked.summary: Recent benchmarks and generative frameworks extend AI structure and design tools to aptamers, RNA, antibodies, and CRISPR nucleases.

ranked.headline: Coalescent and drift methods infer selection and demography from genome-wide variation
ranked.summary: Analytically tractable coalescent length distributions and fitted baselines now enable joint quantification of selection and demography from sequence data.

ranked.headline: Learned models refine cryo-EM segmentation, tilt-series alignment, and particle picking…
ranked.summary: Learned models and a 37M-particle annotated dataset are improving automated cryo-EM and cryo-ET processing steps.

ranked.headline: Long reads and proximity ligation yield chromosome-scale genome assemblies across taxa
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published report add chromosome-level references, with C. briggsae reaching telomere-to-telomere gap-free resolution.

ranked.headline: Phylogenetic tools target model choice, population structure, and tree data reuse
ranked.summary: Recent releases add mixture models, concordance factors, and interactive visualization to phylogenetic workflows.

ranked.headline: Hybrid and reduced-precision stochastic solvers for multiscale biological models
ranked.summary: Three recent items address hybrid, reduced-precision and structure-preserving numerical methods for biological simulation.

ranked.headline: Haplotype-resolved genomes reveal structural substrates of eukaryotic evolution
ranked.summary: Haplotype-resolved and near-complete assemblies now span fungi, legumes, CAM plants and crops, enabling direct structural comparison across lineages.

ranked.headline: Packaged tools make genomic and network analyses interactive and reproducible
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers bundle GWAS, interactome, gene retrieval, SNP-pathway and GSEA workflows into automated, accessible software.

ranked.headline: Model structure shapes inferred ancestral, RNA-ensemble and introgression estimates
ranked.summary: Recent methods treat generative model structure, from indels to across-site heterogeneity, as a determinant of inferred parameters.

ranked.headline: Pipelines reconstruct viral genomes and phylogenies directly from raw sequencing reads
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications benchmark or validate reference-independent and assembly-free pipelines for viral surveillance and metagenomic detection.

ranked.headline: Dynamic-systems models integrate genetic, environmental, omic, and aging-clock data
ranked.summary: Longitudinal cohorts and public omic compendia now permit systems-level modeling of genetic and temporal risk.

ranked.headline: Genetic variants guide disease prioritization, subtyping, and risk prediction
ranked.summary: Large multi-cohort and multi-ancestry genetic datasets now enable variant-to-target, subtype, and risk-model analyses at scale.
